_info: Bruno at the desk (Préfecture sim): what customers say at the mairie reception, the ANEF help point and the CAF / sécurité sociale point of the invented town of Montbruno. Standard French of France at A2-B1 (variety fr-FR, the content being learnt) in `de` (key kept), the English meaning in `en`. COMPLET lines (`genehmigt`) and INCOMPLET lines (`abgelehnt`) never say anything about anybody's status. Humour about paperwork and queues, never about people or where they come from.

gruss.en: Hello. At last, it’s my turn.

gruss.de: Bonsoir… euh, bonjour ! Quelle queue aujourd’hui !
gruss.en: Good evening… er, good morning! What a queue today!

gruss.de: Bonjour. J’espère que j’ai tout apporté.
gruss.en: Hello. I hope I’ve brought everything.

genehmigt.en: Perfect, thank you very much! Have a nice day!

genehmigt.de: Merci. Et moi qui croyais qu’il me manquait quelque chose !
genehmigt.en: Thanks. And I thought I was missing something!

abgelehnt.de: Ah, d’accord. Je comprends. Je reviens quand je l’aurai.
abgelehnt.en: Oh, OK. I understand. I’ll come back when I have it.

abgelehnt.de: Zut ! Bon, ce n’est pas grave. Je vais le chercher.
abgelehnt.en: Oh dear! Well, never mind. I’ll go and get it.

abgelehnt.de: Les papiers, toujours les papiers… Mais vous avez raison. À tout à l’heure !
abgelehnt.en: Paperwork, always paperwork… But you’re right. See you later!

abgelehnt.de: D’accord, merci de me l’avoir expliqué. Je reviens un autre jour.
abgelehnt.en: All right, thanks for explaining. I’ll come back another day.

zurueck.de: Me revoilà. Cette fois, j’ai tout.
zurueck.en: I’m back. This time I have everything.
Hello again. Look, I’ve got it now.

warten.en: Excuse me, will it take long?
